sentences.sanskrit: या कुन्देन्दुतुषारहारधवला या शुभ्रवस्त्रावृता या वीणावरदण्डमण्डितकरा या श्वेतपद्मासना । या ब्रह्माच्युतशङ्करप्रभृतिभिर्देवैः सदा वन्दिता सा मां पातु सरस्वती भगवती निःशेषजाड्यापहा ॥ १ ॥
sentences.meaning: May Goddess Saraswati, who is as fair as a jasmine flower, the moon, or a garland of snow; who is adorned in radiant white garments; whose hands are adorned with the sacred veena; who is seated upon a pure white lotus; who is perpetually adored by Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, and all the gods; completely remove all my ignorance and protect me.

sentences.sanskrit: शुक्लां ब्रह्मविचारसारपरमां आद्यां जगद्व्यापिनीं वीणापुस्तकधारिणीमभयदां जाड्यान्धकारापहाम् । हस्ते स्फाटिकमालिकां विदधतीं पद्मासने संस्थितां वन्दे तां परमेश्वरीं भगवतीं बुद्धिप्रदां शारदाम् ॥ २ ॥
sentences.meaning: I salute the Supreme Goddess Sharada (Saraswati), who is pure white; who is the supreme essence of the inquiry into the ultimate truth (Brahman); who is the primal power pervading the entire cosmos; who holds the veena and the book of wisdom; who grants fearlessness and dispels the darkness of ignorance; who holds a rosary of crystal beads; who is seated in the lotus posture; and who bestows intellect and wisdom.

sentences.sanskrit: सरस्वति नमस्तुभ्यं वरदे कामरूपिणि । विद्यारम्भं करिष्यामि सिद्धिर्भवतु मे सदा ॥ ३ ॥
sentences.meaning: O Goddess Saraswati, salutations to You! O giver of boons, O one who can assume any form! I am going to commence my studies, may success and mastery always attend me.
Chapter 1: Salutations to Mother India (वन्दे भारतमातरम्)

sentences.sanskrit: अम्ब ! वयं विभिन्नेषु कार्यक्रमेषु, आकाशवाण्यां, शालायां च ‘वन्दे मातरम्’ इति गीतं बहुत्र शृणुमः । किन्तु अस्य अर्थं न जानीमः । मातः ! अस्य कः अर्थः ? ‘इदं गीतं कः लिखितवान्’ इत्यपि मम जिज्ञासा अस्ति ।
sentences.meaning: Mother! In various programs, on the radio, and in school, we hear the song 'Vande Mataram' in many places. But we do not know its meaning. Mother! What is its meaning? 'Who wrote this song?' is also my curiosity.

sentences.sanskrit: मातः ! इदं गीतं कस्यां भाषायाम् अस्ति ? पुत्रि ! एतत् गीतं संस्कृतं बाङ्ग्ला च इति भाषाद्वये वर्तते । मातः ! अस्मिन् गीते वर्ण्यः विषयः कः अस्ति ? पुत्र ! अस्मिन् गीते भारतमातुः स्वरूपस्य रम्यं वर्णनम् अस्ति ।
sentences.meaning: Mother! In which language is this song? Daughter! This song is in two languages: Sanskrit and Bengali. Mother! What is the theme described in this song? Son! In this song, there is a charming description of the form of Mother India.

sentences.sanskrit: वत्सौ ! महान् देशभक्तः बङ्किमचन्द्रः चट्टोपाध्यायः १८८२ तमे वर्षे ‘आनन्दमठः’ इति नामकम् उपन्यासम् लिखितवान् । ‘वन्दे मातरम्’ इति गीतं तस्मिन् एव उपन्यासे वर्तते । ‘वन्दे मातरम्’ इत्यस्य अर्थः अस्ति यत् ‘अहं मातुः वन्दनं करोमि’ इति । अम्ब ! एतस्य गीतस्य किं वैशिष्ट्यम् ? बालौ ! स्वतन्त्रतायाः आन्दोलने सर्वे देशभक्ताः एतत् गीतं मन्त्रम् इव गायन्ति स्म ।
sentences.meaning: Dear children! The great patriot Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay wrote a novel named 'Anandamath' in the year 1882. The song 'Vande Mataram' is in that very novel. The meaning of 'Vande Mataram' is 'I bow down to Mother'. Mother! What is the special feature of this song? Children! In the freedom movement, all patriots used to sing this song like a sacred mantra.

sentences.sanskrit: सम्प्रति अपि इदं गीतं श्रुत्वा गीत्वा च वयं सर्वे भारतीयाः प्रेरिताः भवामः । मातः ! ‘वन्दे मातरम्’ इति गीतस्य अर्थः इतिहासः च कियान् महान् अस्ति खलु ! अम्ब ! आवाम् अस्माकं राष्ट्रध्वजस्य विषये अपि किञ्चित् ज्ञातुम् इच्छावः ।
sentences.meaning: Even now, hearing and singing this song, all of us Indians become inspired. Mother! How truly great is the meaning and history of the song 'Vande Mataram'! Mother! We both also wish to know something about our National Flag.

sentences.sanskrit: साधु, अधुना वयं भारतमातुः त्रिवर्णध्वजस्य च विषये जानीमः । एषा अस्माकं वत्सला भारतमाता । अहो अस्माकं भारतमातुः माहात्म्यम् !
sentences.meaning: Splendid! Now let us learn about Mother India and her tricolour flag. This is our affectionate Mother India. Oh, how glorious is the greatness of our Mother India!

sentences.sanskrit: साक्षात् पर्वतराजः हिमालयः मुकुटरूपेण अस्याः मस्तके शोभते । अस्याः चरणौ प्रक्षालयति स्वयं रत्नाकरः समुद्रः । भारतभूमौ महेन्द्रः, मलयः, सह्यः, रैवतकः, विन्ध्यः, अरावलिः इत्यादयः श्रेष्ठाः पर्वताः विराजन्ते ।
sentences.meaning: The king of mountains, the Himalayas, truly adorns her head like a crown. The ocean, the storehouse of jewels, washes her feet himself. On the land of India, great and majestic mountains like Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Raivataka, Vindhya, and Aravali stand grandly.

sentences.sanskrit: अत्रैव गङ्गा, यमुना, सरस्वती, सिन्धुः, ब्रह्मपुत्रः, गण्डकी, महानदी, नर्मदा, गोदावरी, कृष्णा, कावेरी इत्यादयः पवित्राः नद्यः प्रवहन्ति । नद्यः अपि अस्माकं मातरः इव । अयोध्या, मथुरा, हरिद्वारम्, काशी, काञ्ची, अवन्तिका, वैशाली, द्वारिका, पूरी, गया, प्रयागः, पाटलीपुत्रम्, विजयनगरम्, इन्द्रप्रस्थम्, सोमनाथः, अमृतसरः इत्यादीनि मङ्गलानि तीर्थक्षेत्राणि नगराणि च भारतभूमौ एव सुशोभन्ते । एतेषां तीर्थक्षेत्राणां धूलिम् ललाटे स्थापयितुं विविधेभ्यः प्रदेशेभ्यः असंख्याः जनाः आगच्छन्ति ।
sentences.meaning: Here alone flow holy rivers such as the Ganga, Yamuna, Saraswati, Sindhu, Brahmaputra, Gandaki, Mahanadi, Narmada, Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri. These rivers, too, are just like our mothers. Auspicious pilgrimage sites and historical cities like Ayodhya, Mathura, Haridwar, Kashi, Kanchi, Avantika, Vaishali, Dwarika, Puri, Gaya, Prayag, Pataliputra, Vijayanagar, Indraprastha, Somnath, and Amritsar look beautiful only on this land of India. Countless people travel from various regions just to apply the holy dust of these sacred places onto their foreheads.

sentences.sanskrit: भारतमातुः हस्ते विलसति त्रिवर्णयुतः राष्ट्रध्वजः । अहो अस्य शोभा ! अस्मिन् राष्ट्रध्वजे केशरः, श्वेतः, हरितः च वर्णाः विराजन्ते । ध्वजस्य मध्ये सुन्दरं नीलवर्णं चक्रमपि शोभते । ध्वजे विराजमानः वर्णाः चक्रं च विशिष्टं सन्देशं प्रयच्छन्ति ।
sentences.meaning: In the hand of Mother India shines our tricolour National Flag. Oh, how beautiful it looks! In this national flag, saffron, white, and green colours look splendid. A beautiful blue-coloured wheel also shines in the center of the flag. The colours and the wheel present on the flag deliver a special message.

sentences.sanskrit: त्रिवर्णध्वजस्य ऊर्ध्वभागे विराजते केशरवर्णः । एषः वर्णः त्यागपरम्परायाः शौर्यपरम्परायाः च सूचकः अस्ति । ये भारतमातुः आजीवनं सेवां कृतवन्तः, देशस्य स्वतन्त्रतां प्राप्तुं सहर्षं स्वप्राणान् अर्पितवन्तः च, तेषां वीराणां बलिदानं सूचयति एषः वर्णः । ‘जयतु सैनिकः’ इति वक्तुम् अस्मान् प्रेरयति ध्वजस्थितः अयं केशरवर्णः ।
sentences.meaning: The saffron colour shines at the top section of the tricolour flag. This colour is an indicator of the traditions of sacrifice and bravery. It signifies the ultimate sacrifice of those heroes who served Mother India throughout their lives and happily offered their own lives to achieve the independence of the nation. This saffron colour situated on the flag inspires us to proclaim, 'Victory to the soldier!'

sentences.sanskrit: कृषकबान्धवाः अस्माकं भारतभूमिं सर्वदा स्व-स्वेदबिन्दुभिः सिञ्चन्ति । एतेषां परिश्रमणेन एव भारतभूमिः हरितवर्णमयी समृद्धा सस्यश्यामला च सञ्जाता । भारतमातुः समृद्धेः एषा आभा हरितवर्णरूपेण अस्माकं राष्ट्रध्वजे विराजते । ‘जयतु कृषकः’ इति वक्तुम् अस्मान् प्रेरयति ध्वजस्थितः एषः हरितवर्णः ।
sentences.meaning: Our farmer brothers always irrigate the land of India with the drops of their sweat. It is solely due to their hard work that the land of India has become green, prosperous, and abundant with crops. This glow of Mother India's prosperity shines in the form of the green colour on our national flag. This green colour on the flag inspires us to say, 'Victory to the farmer!'

sentences.sanskrit: मध्यस्थितः श्वेतवर्णः शान्तेः सत्यस्य च द्योतकः अस्ति । अणुशास्त्रे, सङ्गणकशास्त्रे, चिकित्साशास्त्रे, अन्तरिक्षशास्त्रे, आयुधशास्त्रे इत्यादिषु विज्ञानस्य विभिन्नषु क्षेत्रेषु भारतीयैः वैज्ञानिकैः महत् यशः प्राप्तम् अस्ति । वैज्ञानिकानां तत् धवलं यशः धवलवर्णरूपेण राष्ट्रध्वजस्य मध्ये विलसति । भारतीयं विज्ञानं शान्तिं प्रगतिं सुरक्षां च परिपोषयति ।
sentences.meaning: The white colour situated in the middle is a symbol of peace and truth. In various fields of science, such as nuclear science, computer science, medical science, space science, and weapon technology, Indian scientists have achieved immense glory. That bright, spotless glory of the scientists shines beautifully right in the middle of the national flag in the form of the white colour. Indian science nurtures and sustains peace, progress, and security.

sentences.sanskrit: ‘जयतु वैज्ञानिकः’ इति वक्तुम् अस्मान् प्रेरयति ध्वजमध्यस्थः अयं धवलवर्णः । ध्वजे विराजमानस्य घननीलवर्णस्य चक्रस्य नाम धर्मचक्रम् इति । अस्मिन् चक्रे चतुर्विंशतिः अराः सन्ति । एतत् चक्रं ‘चलनीयं कर्तव्यपथे वै, न विरम, सततं चल’ इति भावं बोधयति । सूर्यः विरामं विना नित्यं सञ्चरति ।
sentences.meaning: This white colour in the middle of the flag inspires us to declare, 'Victory to the scientist!' The name of the navy-blue wheel situated on the flag is the Dharma Chakra (Wheel of Righteousness). There are twenty-four spokes in this wheel. This wheel awakens the feeling of: 'One must keep moving on the path of duty, do not stop, keep moving constantly.' The sun travels daily without taking a break.

sentences.sanskrit: नदी कष्टानि सहमाना अपि ध्येयं प्रति नित्यं प्रवहति । इदं चक्रं ‘जीवने श्रान्तेः, आलस्यस्य प्रमादस्य च स्थानं न भवतु’ इति सन्देशं प्रयच्छति । वयं सर्वेऽपि धन्याः यत् अस्यां पवित्रभूम्यां जन्म प्राप्तवन्तः । वयं पवित्रायाः भारतमातुः नित्यं वन्दनं कुर्मः अस्याः गौरववर्धनार्थं च प्रयत्नं कुर्मः ।
sentences.meaning: A river, even while enduring many hardships, flows daily toward its goal. This wheel gives the message that: 'There should be no place for tiredness, laziness, or carelessness in life.' We all are blessed that we have taken birth on this sacred land. We bow to our pure Mother India every single day and make consistent efforts to increase her glory.

sentences.sanskrit: वयं बालका भारतभक्ताः वयं बालिका भारतभक्ताः । वयं हि सर्वे भारतभक्ताः पृथिवीं स्वर्गं जेतुं शक्ताः ॥
sentences.meaning: We boys are devotees of India, we girls are devotees of India. Indeed, we all are devotees of India, capable of conquering the earth and transforming it into heaven!

sentences.sanskrit: सुशीला: महोदय! अस्माकं विद्यालयस्य भित्तौ ‘अयोग्यः पुरुषो नास्ति योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः’ इति लिखितम् अस्ति। अस्य कः भावः इति कृपया बोधयतु।
sentences.meaning: Sushila: Sir! On our school wall, it is written: 'No man is completely useless; it is a coordinator/connector who is rare to find.' Please explain its meaning.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सुशीला: महोदय! हमारे विद्यालय की दीवार पर लिखा है— 'अयोग्यः पुरुषो नास्ति योजकस्तत्र दुर्लभः'। कृपया बताइए कि इसका क्या भाव है?

sentences.sanskrit: शिक्षकः: भोः सुशीले! अस्य भावार्थः अस्ति यत् अस्मिन् जगति कोऽपि अयोग्यः नास्ति। सर्वे योग्याः सन्ति परन्तु प्रेरकस्य मार्गदर्शकस्य च अभावः अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Oh Sushila! The meaning is that in this world, nobody is incompetent or useless. Everyone possesses capability, but there is a lack of someone who can inspire and guide them properly.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: शिक्षक: अरे सुशीला! इसका भावार्थ है कि इस संसार में कोई भी मनुष्य सर्वथा अयोग्य नहीं है। सभी योग्य हैं, परन्तु उन्हें सही दिशा दिखाने वाले प्रेरक और मार्गदर्शक की कमी है।

sentences.sanskrit: रमा: मान्यवर! अहम् अपि विद्यालयस्य परिसरे एतादृशं श्लोकं पठितवती। महोदय! सुभाषितानि इत्यनेन कः अभिप्रायः?
sentences.meaning: Rama: Respected Sir! I also read a similar shloka on the school premises. Sir, what is meant by Subhashitani?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: रमा: आदरणीय महोदय! मैंने भी विद्यालय परिसर में ऐसा ही श्लोक पढ़ा था। महोदय! "सुभाषितानि" से क्या अभिप्राय है?

sentences.sanskrit: शिक्षकः: रमे! एतानि सुभाषितानि सन्ति। अस्माकं चिन्तनविकासाय एव एतानि सुभाषितानि विद्यालयस्य परिसरे स्थापितानि। वत्स! मानवानां विविधमूल्यानां विकासाय श्रेष्ठजनैः उक्तानि सुवचनानि एव सुभाषितानि।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Rama! These are Subhashitas (wise sayings). These wise sayings are put up around the school premises to develop our thinking capacity. Child! The good and noble words spoken by great people for developing various human values are called Subhashitas.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: शिक्षक: रमा! ये सुभाषित हैं। हमारे चिन्तन और विचारों के विकास के लिए ही ये सुभाषित विद्यालय परिसर में लगाए गए हैं। बेटी! मानवों के विविध जीवन-मूल्यों के विकास के लिए श्रेष्ठ और महापुरुषों द्वारा कहे गए सुंदर वचनों को ही 'सुभाषित' कहते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: सुरेशः: श्रीमन्! सुभाषितानां पठनेन कः लाभः? अहो, वयम् अपि सुभाषितानि पठितुम् इच्छामः। कृपया अस्मान् पाठयतु।
sentences.meaning: Suresh: Respected Sir! What is the benefit of reading Subhashitas? Oh, we also wish to read Subhashitas. Please teach us.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सुरेश: श्रीमान्! सुभाषित पढ़ने से क्या लाभ होता है? अरे! हम भी सुभाषित पढ़ना चाहते हैं। कृपया हमें पढ़ाइए।

sentences.sanskrit: शिक्षकः: प्रियसुरेश! सुभाषितानां पठनेन अस्माकं नैतिकः सामाजिकः च विकासः भवति। अस्माभिः किं कर्तव्यं किञ्च न कर्तव्यम् इति सुभाषितानि बोधयन्ति। समीचीनम्, तर्हि वयं सुभाषितानां रसं पिबामः।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Dear Suresh! Reading Subhashitas fosters our moral and social development. Subhashitas guide us on what should be done and what should not be done. Splendid, then let us drink the nectar of Subhashitas.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: शिक्षक: प्रिय सुरेश! सुभाषितों के अध्ययन से हमारा नैतिक और सामाजिक विकास होता है। हमें क्या करना चाहिए और क्या नहीं करना चाहिए, यह सुभाषित हमें सिखाते हैं। बहुत अच्छा, तो आइए हम सब सुभाषितों का रस पीते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: वस्त्रेण वपुषा वाचा विद्यया विनयेन च । वकारैः पञ्चभिर्युक्तो नरो भवति पूजितः ॥ १ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 1 · The Five V-Attributes (पञ्च वकाराः): A person who is endowed with these five attributes starting with the letter 'V'—Vastra (appropriate clothing), Vapu (a healthy physique), Vaak (polite and beneficial speech), Vidya (education/knowledge), and Vinaya (humility)—is respected and worshipped everywhere in the world.

sentences.sanskrit: षड् दोषाः पुरुषेणेह हातव्या भूतिमिच्छता । निद्रा तन्द्रा भयं क्रोध आलस्यं दीर्घसूत्रता ॥ २ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 2 · The Six Flaws to Avoid (षड् दोषाः): A person who desires prosperity, wealth, and success in life must abandon six flaws: Nidra (excessive sleep), Tandra (drowsiness/lethargy), Bhayam (fear), Krodha (anger), Aalasya (laziness), and Dirghasutrata (procrastination / delaying tasks).

sentences.sanskrit: अद्भिर्गात्राणि शुध्यन्ति मनः सत्येन शुध्यति । विद्यातपोभ्यां भूतात्मा बुद्धिर्ज्ञानेन शुध्यति ॥ ३ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 3 · Purification (शुद्धिकरणम्): The limbs of the body are cleansed by Ap (water); the mind is purified by Satya (truthfulness); the individual soul (Bhutatma) is purified through Vidya (knowledge) and Tapas (penance/hard work); and the intellect (Buddhi) is purified by Jnana (true wisdom).

sentences.sanskrit: उत्तरं यत् समुद्रस्य हिमाद्रेश्चैव दक्षिणम् । वर्षं तद् भारतं नाम भारती यत्र सन्ततिः ॥ ४ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 4 · Geography of India (भारतस्य भौगोलिकं स्वरूपम्): The land mass situated to the north of the (Indian) ocean and to the south of the snowy mountains (the Himalayas) is called Bharatavarsham. The citizens residing here are famously known as Bharatiya.

sentences.sanskrit: जलबिन्दुनिपातेन क्रमशः पूर्यते घटः । स हेतुः सर्वविद्यानां धर्मस्य च धनस्य च ॥ ५ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 5 · The Power of Continuity (निरन्तरप्रयासः): Just as a pot gets completely filled drop by drop by the constant falling of water, similarly, through continuous practice and patience over time, a person acquires all types of Vidya (knowledge), Dharma (righteousness), and Dhana (wealth).

sentences.sanskrit: यः पठति लिखति पश्यति परिपृच्छति पण्डितानुपाश्रयति । तस्य दिवाकरकिरणैः नलिनीदलमिव विस्तारिता बुद्धिः ॥ ६ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 6 · Expansion of Intellect (बुद्धेः विकासः): One who constantly reads, writes, observes, asks clarifying questions, and seeks the shelter/company of wise people expands their intellect in the same manner as a lotus petal fully blooms when touched by the rays of Divakara (the sun).

sentences.sanskrit: प्रियवाक्यप्रदानेन सर्वे तुष्यन्ति जन्तवः । तस्मात्तदेव वक्तव्यं वचने का दरिद्रता ॥ ७ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 7 · Sweet Speech (प्रियवाक्यम्): All living beings feel content and happy when sweet and pleasant words are spoken to them. Therefore, one should always speak sweetly; what is the point of being miserable or poor in using pleasant words?

sentences.sanskrit: आलस्यं हि मनुष्याणां शरीरस्थो महान् रिपुः । नास्त्युद्यमसमो बन्धुः कृत्वा यं नावसीदति ॥ ८ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 8 · Hard Work vs. Laziness (उद्यमः): Laziness is indeed the greatest enemy residing inside the human body. There is no true companion or friend equal to Udyama (hard work/effort), because a person who works hard never faces sorrow or grief.

sentences.sanskrit: अष्टादशपुराणेषु व्यासस्य वचनद्वयम् । परोपकारः पुण्याय पापाय परपीडनम् ॥ ९ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 9 · Helping Others (परोपकारः): Out of all the eighteen Puranas composed by Sage Vyasa, his entire message can be summed up in just two sentences: Paropakara (helping others) generates merit (Punya), while Parapeedanam (harming/hurting others) results in sin (Paapa).

sentences.meaning: 1. Answer the following questions in one word:
sentences.hindi_gloss: १. निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर एक शब्द में लिखिए:

sentences.meaning: How many 'V' attributes make a person respected? Answer: Five (पञ्चभिः).
sentences.hindi_gloss: मनुष्य कितने वकारों से पूजित/सम्मानित होता है? उत्तर: पाँच (पञ्चभिः)।

sentences.meaning: How many flaws/vices should be discarded by a person in this world? Answer: Six (षड्).
sentences.hindi_gloss: उन्नति चाहने वाले पुरुष को कितने दोष त्याग देने चाहिए? उत्तर: छह (षड्)।

sentences.meaning: By what is the intellect purified? Answer: By knowledge (ज्ञानेन).
sentences.hindi_gloss: बुद्धि किससे शुद्ध होती है? उत्तर: ज्ञान से (ज्ञानेन)।

sentences.meaning: What is filled gradually by the falling of water drops? Answer: A pot (घटः).
sentences.hindi_gloss: जल की बूँदों के लगातार गिरने से क्रमशः क्या भर जाता है? उत्तर: घड़ा (घटः)।

sentences.meaning: Of whom is laziness the greatest enemy? Answer: Of human beings (मनुष्याणाम्).
sentences.hindi_gloss: आलस्य किनका सबसे बड़ा शत्रु है? उत्तर: मनुष्यों का (मनुष्याणाम्)।

sentences.meaning: 2. Answer the following questions in a full sentence:
sentences.hindi_gloss: २. निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर पूर्ण वाक्य में लिखिए:

sentences.answer_sanskrit: नरः वस्त्रेण, वपुषा, वाचा, विद्यया, विनयेन च एतैः पञ्चभिः वकारैः युक्तः पूजितो भवति।
sentences.meaning: How does a man become respected/honoured? -> A man becomes respected when he is endowed with these five 'V's: fine attire (Vastra), a healthy physique (Vapu), pleasant speech (Vach), knowledge (Vidya), and humility (Vinaya).
sentences.hindi_gloss: मनुष्य किस प्रकार सम्मानित होता है? -> मनुष्य वस्त्र, सुंदर शरीर, मधुर वाणी, विद्या और विनय—इन पाँच 'व' से युक्त होकर सम्मानित होता है।

sentences.answer_sanskrit: पुरुषेण निद्रा, तन्द्रा, भयं, क्रोधः, आलस्यं, दीर्घसूत्रता च एते षड् दोषाः हातव्याः।
sentences.meaning: Which flaws should be given up by a person? -> The six flaws that should be discarded by a person are sleep, lethargy, fear, anger, laziness, and procrastination.
sentences.hindi_gloss: पुरुष को कौन-से दोष त्याग देने चाहिए? -> पुरुष को नींद, सुस्ती/ऊँघना, भय, क्रोध, आलस्य और काम टालने की आदत (दीर्घसूत्रता)—ये छह दोष त्याग देने चाहिए।

sentences.answer_sanskrit: यः पठति, लिखति, पश्यति, परिपृच्छति, पण्डितान् उपाश्रयति च तस्य बुद्धिः विस्तारिता भवति।
sentences.meaning: Whose intellect/mind becomes expanded? -> The intellect of a person who reads, writes, observes, questions, and takes refuge in wise scholars becomes expanded.
sentences.hindi_gloss: किसकी बुद्धि का विस्तार होता है? -> जो पढ़ता है, लिखता है, देखता है, प्रश्न पूछता है और विद्वानों का आश्रय लेता है, उसकी बुद्धि विस्तृत होती है।

sentences.meaning: Doing what does a person never grieve/suffer? -> A person never suffers or grieves after putting in hard work/effort.
sentences.hindi_gloss: क्या करके मनुष्य कभी दुखी नहीं होता? -> परिश्रम (उद्यम) करके मनुष्य कभी दुखी या निराश नहीं होता।

sentences.answer_sanskrit: व्यासस्य वचनद्वयम् अस्ति - "परोपकारः पुण्याय, पापाय परपीडनम्" इति।
sentences.meaning: What are the two direct sayings of Sage Vyasa? -> The two maxims of Vyasa are: "Helping others leads to spiritual merit, and hurting others leads to sin."
sentences.hindi_gloss: महर्षि वेदव्यास के दो प्रमुख वचन क्या हैं? -> वेदव्यास के दो मुख्य वचन हैं: "दूसरों की भलाई (परोपकार) करना पुण्य है, और दूसरों को सताना/दुख देना पाप है।"

sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे योगिता! तुम सुबह क्या करती हो?

sentences.sanskrit: योगिता: अहं प्रतिदिनं प्रातः पित्रा सह उद्यानं गच्छामि।
sentences.meaning: Yogita: Every morning I go to the park with my father.

sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे योगासन! हम सब भी जानना चाहते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: योगिता: तर्हि वयं सर्वे योगशिक्षिकायाः समीपं गच्छामः।

sentences.paragraphTranslation: तुम्हारा कल्याण हो। सभी बैठ जाइए।

sentences.sanskrit: छात्राः: आचार्ये ! किम् अद्य भवान् अस्मान् योगासनं शिक्षयति ?
sentences.meaning: Students: Teacher! Will you teach us yogasanas today?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्या जी! क्या आज आप हमें योगासन सिखाएँगी?

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्या: निश्चयेन, वदन्तु किम् आसनं शिक्षितुम् इच्छन्ति ?

sentences.paragraphTranslation: ज़रूर, बताइए आप कौन सा आसन सीखना चाहते हैं?

sentences.meaning: Yogita: Teacher! Please teach us Surya Namaskar today.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्या जी! आज सूर्यनमस्कार सिखाइए।

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्या: समीचीनम्। सूर्यनमस्कारः द्वादशानाम् आसनानां समाहारः अस्ति। प्रत्येकस्मात् सूर्यनमस्कारात् पूर्वम् एकः मन्त्रः भवति। तेषु प्रथमः मन्त्रः अस्ति – 'ॐ मित्राय नमः' इति।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Very well. Surya Namaskar is a synthesis of twelve postures. Before each Surya Namaskar posture there is a sacred mantra. The first among them is – 'Om Mitraya Namah'.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बहुत अच्छा। सूर्यनमस्कार बारह आसनों का समूह है। हर सूर्यनमस्कार से पहले एक मन्त्र होता है। उनमें पहला मन्त्र है– 'ॐ मित्राय नमः' ।

sentences.meaning: Students: Yes, revered madam! We remember......
The Twelve Sacred Mantras of Surya Namaskar
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सूर्यनमस्कार के बारह मन्त्र

sentences.meaning: 1. Om Mitraya Namah — Salutations to the universal Friend who brings light and life to all.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: १. ॐ मित्राय नमः — सबके मित्र सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 2. Om Ravaye Namah — Salutations to the Radiant, Shining Light.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: २. ॐ रवये नमः — प्रकाशमान सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 3. Om Suryaya Namah — Salutations to the Supreme Guide and Dispeller of Darkness.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ३. ॐ सूर्याय नमः — अंधकार को दूर करने वाले सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 4. Om Bhanave Namah — Salutations to the Illuminator who shines gloriously.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ४. ॐ भानवे नमः — प्रकाशक सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 5. Om Khagaya Namah — Salutations to the One who traverses across the cosmic sky.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ५. ॐ खगाय नमः — आकाश में विचरण करने वाले सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 6. Om Pushne Namah — Salutations to the Nourisher and Sustainer of the Earth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ६. ॐ पूष्णे नमः — संसार का पोषण करने वाले सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 7. Om Hiranyagarbhaya Namah — Salutations to the Golden Cosmic Being of divine origin.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ७. ॐ हिरण्यगर्भाय नमः — सुवर्ण के समान कान्ति वाले परमात्मा स्वरूप सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 8. Om Marichaye Namah — Salutations to the Master of infinite rays of dawn.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ८. ॐ मरीचये नमः — किरणों के स्वामी सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 9. Om Adityaya Namah — Salutations to the Divine Son of cosmic eternity (Aditi).
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ९. ॐ आदित्याय नमः — माता अदिति के तेजस्वी पुत्र सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 10. Om Savitre Namah — Salutations to the Creator and Awakener of all life.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: १०. ॐ सवित्रे नमः — सम्पूर्ण जगत् को उत्पन्न करने वाले सविता को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 11. Om Arkaya Namah — Salutations to the Resplendent One worthy of highest reverence.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ११. ॐ अर्काय नमः — पूजनीय सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: 12. Om Bhaskaraya Namah — Salutations to the Illuminator who creates daylight and brilliance.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: १२. ॐ भास्कराय नमः — प्रकाश करने वाले सूर्य को प्रणाम।

sentences.meaning: Concluding Mantra: Om Savitru-Surya-Narayanaya Namah — Salutations to the Supreme Lord Narayana manifested in the Sun.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सबके अंत में: ॐ सवितृसूर्यनारायणाय नमः — भगवान सूर्यनारायण को नमस्कार।

sentences.meaning: Benefits of Surya Namaskar
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सूर्यनमस्कार के लाभ

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्या: अत्युत्तमम्। इदानीम् एकेन श्लोकेन सूर्यनमस्कारस्य बहूनि प्रयोजनानि वदामि। भवन्तः शृण्वन्तु अनुवदन्तु च।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Excellent! Now through a shloka, I shall explain many benefits of Surya Namaskar. Please listen and repeat after me.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बहुत बढ़िया। अब मैं एक श्लोक के माध्यम से सूर्यनमस्कार के कई लाभ बताती हूँ। आप सब सुनिए और दोहराइए।

sentences.sanskrit: आदित्यस्य नमस्कारान् ये कुर्वन्ति दिने दिने। आयुः प्रज्ञा बलं वीर्यं तेजस्तेषां च जायते ॥
sentences.meaning: Those who perform salutations to the Sun day after day; their longevity, wisdom, physical strength, vitality, and brilliance increase abundantly.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: जो लोग प्रतिदिन सूर्य नमस्कार करते हैं, उनकी आयु, बुद्धि, बल, वीर्य और तेज में वृद्धि होती है।

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्या: एवं योगासनेषु सूर्यनमस्कारः एकः श्रेष्ठः आसनक्रमः अस्ति। सूर्यनमस्कारेण शारीरिकं, मानसिकम्, आध्यात्मिकं च बलं वर्धते। अतः वयं प्रतिदिनं सूर्यनमस्कारं करवाम। 'स्वस्थं शरीरं स्वस्थं मनः' च प्राप्नवाम। अस्तु, पुनः अग्रिमकक्षायाम् अन्येषाम् आसनानां विषये ज्ञास्यामः।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Thus among yogasanas, Surya Namaskar is a supreme sequence of postures. Through Surya Namaskar, physical, mental, and spiritual vigor grows. Therefore let us practice Surya Namaskar daily to achieve a healthy body and healthy mind. Well, in the next class we will explore other yogasanas.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: इस प्रकार योगासनों में सूर्यनमस्कार एक सर्वश्रेष्ठ आसन क्रम है। सूर्यनमस्कार से शारीरिक, मानसिक और आध्यात्मिक बल बढ़ता है। इसलिए हमें रोज़ सूर्यनमस्कार करना चाहिए, जिससे हम 'स्वस्थ शरीर और स्वस्थ मन' पा सकें। अच्छा, अगली कक्षा में हम अन्य आसनों के बारे में जानेंगे।

Who says 'May auspiciousness be upon you'? Answer: The teacher (आचार्या).
What does Yogita ask the teacher to teach? Answer: Surya Namaskar (सूर्यनमस्कारम्).

sentences.paragraphTranslation: कक्षा में संवाद: चित्र-दर्शन एवं कथा-प्रस्तावना

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः: प्रियच्छात्राः ! एतत् चित्रं पश्यन्तु। चित्रे किं किम् अस्ति ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Dear students! Look at this picture. What all is there in the picture?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: प्रिय छात्रो! इस चित्र को देखो। चित्र में क्या-क्या है?

sentences.sanskrit: प्रथमः छात्रः: महोदय ! चित्रे वृक्षः अस्ति ।
sentences.meaning: First Student: Sir! There is a tree in the picture.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: महोदय! चित्र में पेड़ है।

sentences.sanskrit: द्वितीयः छात्रः: महोदय ! शृगालः अस्ति। द्राक्षाफलानि अपि सन्ति ।
sentences.meaning: Second Student: Sir! There is a fox. There are also grapes.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: महोदय! सियार (लोमड़ी) है। अंगूर भी हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः: बहु सम्यक् । शृगालः किं करोति ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Very good. What is the fox doing?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बहुत अच्छे। सियार क्या कर रहा है?

sentences.sanskrit: तृतीयः छात्रः: आचार्य ! शृगालः द्राक्षाफलानि खादितुम् इच्छति, किन्तु न शक्नोति ।
sentences.meaning: Third Student: Teacher! The fox wants to eat the grapes, but cannot reach them.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्य! सियार अंगूर खाना चाहता है, लेकिन खा नहीं पा रहा है।

sentences.meaning: Teacher: Oh! How do you all know this?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे! आप सब कैसे जानते हैं?

sentences.sanskrit: छात्राः: महोदय ! वयम् एतां कथां मातृभाषया श्रुतवन्तः ।
sentences.meaning: Students: Sir! We have heard this story in our mother tongue.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: महोदय! हमने यह कहानी अपनी मातृभाषा में सुनी है।

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः: बहु समीचीनम्। तर्हि संस्कृतभाषायाम् एतां कथां गीतरूपेण गायामः अभिनयं च कुर्मः।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Very wonderful! Then let us sing this story in Sanskrit as an action-song and enact it.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बहुत बढ़िया। तो संस्कृत भाषा में इस कहानी को गीत के रूप में गाते हैं और अभिनय करते हैं।

sentences.meaning: Students: Yes, Teacher! Please teach us.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ठीक है आचार्य! कृपया पढ़ाइए।

sentences.meaning: Action Song — Part 1: The Fox Enters the Forest
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभिनय-गीत — भाग १: सियार का वन में जाना

sentences.sanskrit: एकः शृगालः । एकः शृगालः वनं गच्छति । पिपासा, तस्य बुभुक्षा । पिपासया बुभुक्षया वनं गच्छति । सः वनं गच्छति, सः वनं गच्छति।
sentences.meaning: There is a fox. A fox wanders into the forest. He suffers from thirst and hunger. Driven by thirst and hunger, he goes into the wild forest. He goes into the forest, he goes into the forest.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: एक सियार है। एक सियार वन में जाता है। उसे प्यास और भूख लगी है। प्यास और भूख के कारण वह वन में जाता है। वह वन में जाता है, वह वन में जाता है।

sentences.sanskrit: तत्र गच्छति, किमपि न लभते । इतोऽपि गच्छति, किमपि न लभते । श्रान्तः जायते, खिन्नः जायते । सः श्रान्तः जायते, खिन्नः जायते । किं च करोति ? सः किं च करोति ?
sentences.meaning: He goes there, he finds nothing. He searches further, he finds nothing. He becomes exhausted, he becomes despondent. He becomes weary and sad. And what does he do? What does he do next?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: वहाँ जाता है, कुछ भी नहीं पाता है। और आगे जाता है, कुछ भी नहीं पाता है। वह थक जाता है, वह दुखी हो जाता है। वह थक जाता है, दुखी हो जाता है। और वह क्या करता है? वह और क्या करता है?

sentences.meaning: Action Song — Part 2: Spotting the Grapes
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभिनय-गीत — भाग २: अंगूर देखना

sentences.sanskrit: वामतः पश्यति, दक्षिणतः पश्यति । अग्रतः पश्यति, पृष्ठतः पश्यति । स्वेदः जायते, तृषा जायते । तस्य स्वेदः जायते, तृषा जायते । किं च पश्यति ? सः किं च पश्यति ?
sentences.meaning: He glances left, he glances right. He peers ahead, he looks behind. Sweat beads up, burning thirst rises. Sweat pours from him, thirst consumes him. And what does he spot? What does he see?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: वह बाईं ओर देखता है, दाईं ओर देखता है। आगे देखता है, पीछे देखता है। उसे पसीना आता है, प्यास लगती है। उसे पसीना आता है, प्यास लगती है। और वह क्या देखता है? वह और क्या देखता है?

sentences.sanskrit: पश्यति द्राक्षालतां । सः पश्यति द्राक्षाफलम् । उपरि उपरि लतासु दृश्यते च तत्फलम् । अनुक्षणं तन्मुखे रसः जायते । किं च करोति ? सः किं च करोति ?
sentences.meaning: He catches sight of a grapevine! He beholds clusters of juicy grapes! High up upon the trellis vines hang those succulent fruits. Instantly his mouth waters with eager anticipation. And what does he do? What does he do now?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: वह अंगूर की बेल देखता है। वह अंगूर का फल देखता है। बेलों पर ऊपर ही ऊपर वह फल दिखाई देता है। उसी क्षण उसके मुँह में पानी (लार) आ जाता है। और वह क्या करता है? वह और क्या करता है?

sentences.meaning: Action Song — Part 3: The Leaping Effort and Retreat
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभिनय-गीत — भाग ३: कूदने का प्रयास और भाग जाना

sentences.sanskrit: एकवारम् उत्पतति, द्विवारम् उत्पतति । त्रिवारम् उत्पतति, पुनः पुनः उत्पतति । स्वेदः जायते, तस्य श्रमः जायते । किं कथयति ? सः किं कथयति ?
sentences.meaning: He leaps up once, he leaps twice! He leaps a third time, repeatedly he leaps into the air! Sweat breaks out, deep exhaustion overtakes him. What does he say? What does he proclaim?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: वह एक बार कूदता है, दो बार कूदता है। तीन बार कूदता है, बार-बार कूदता है। उसे पसीना आता है, उसे थकान होती है। वह क्या कहता है? वह क्या कहता है?

sentences.sanskrit: “आम्लं द्राक्षाफलम् आम्लं द्राक्षाफलम्” । इत्येवं कथयति, सः पलायते । इत्येवं कथयति, सः पलायते ॥
sentences.meaning: "Sour are the grapes! Sour are the grapes!" Declaring this proud excuse, he scurries away into the wilderness.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: “अंगूर खट्टे हैं, अंगूर खट्टे हैं।” ऐसा कहता है और वह भाग जाता है। ऐसा कहता है और वह भाग जाता है।

sentences.meaning: 2. Answer the following questions in one or two words (with English meaning):
Who goes to the forest? Answer: The fox (शृगालः).
What does the fox see? Answer: The grapevine (द्राक्षालताम्).
What arises in the fox's mouth? Answer: Water / saliva (रसः).
What does the fox see on the grapevine? Answer: Grapes (द्राक्षाफलम्).
Where are the grapes seen? Answer: High up on the vines (उपरि उपरि लतासु).
Does the fox jump again and again? Answer: Yes (आम्).
Does the fox obtain the grapes? Answer: No (न).

sentences.sanskrit: ३. अधः प्रदत्तानां प्रश्नानां पूर्णवाक्येन उत्तरं लिखन्तु —

sentences.meaning: How/why does the fox go to the forest? Answer: Driven by thirst and hunger, the fox goes to the forest.

sentences.answer_sanskrit: वनं गत्वा शृगालः श्रान्तः खिन्नः च जायते, तस्य स्वेदः तृषा च जायते।
sentences.meaning: What happens to the fox after going to the forest? Answer: Having gone to the forest, the fox becomes tired and sorrowful; sweat breaks out and thirst intensifies.

sentences.answer_sanskrit: शृगालः उपरि उपरि द्राक्षालतासु द्राक्षाफलं पश्यति।
sentences.meaning: Where does the fox see the grapes? Answer: The fox sees the grapes high up hanging on the grapevines.

sentences.meaning: Seeing the grapes, in whose mouth does water emerge? Answer: Seeing the grapes, saliva waters in the mouth of the fox.
What does the fox say at last? Answer: In the end, the fox declares: 'The grapes are sour!'

6. Construct pairs of sentences applying singular and plural verb forms (with English):

sentences.sanskrit: ७. उदाहरणं दृष्ट्वा वाक्यानि उचितरूपैः पूरयन्तु — (Fill in the blanks with correct verb forms)

Classroom Dialogue: Essential Values for Success
sentences.paragraphTranslation: कक्षा में संवाद: मानवीय गुण एवं सफलता

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्या: प्रियच्छात्राः ! जीवने सफलतायै मानवः किं किम् अर्जयेत् ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Dear students! What all should a human being acquire to achieve success in life?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: प्रिय छात्रो! जीवन में सफलता के लिए मनुष्य को क्या-क्या अर्जित करना चाहिए?

sentences.meaning: Students (diverse voices): Knowledge! Degrees! High positions! Wealth!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: विद्या! उपाधि (डिग्री)! पद/प्रतिष्ठा! धन!

sentences.meaning: Teacher: Is this alone sufficient?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: क्या इतना ही पर्याप्त है?

sentences.sanskrit: एकः छात्रः: अन्यत् किम् आवश्यकं महोदये ?
sentences.meaning: A Student: What else is necessary, respected Teacher?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: और क्या आवश्यक है महोदया?

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्या: मानवीयाः गुणाः अपि आवश्यकाः भोः ! यथा सिद्धार्थस्य जीवने विद्या, धनं, पदं च सर्वमपि आसीत्। किन्तु मानवीयगुणैः एव सः महात्मा बुद्धः जातः ।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Humane virtues are also essential, dear ones! Just as in Siddhartha's life, there was learning, wealth, and royal rank; yet it was through noble human virtues alone that he became Gautama Buddha.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे! मानवीय गुण भी आवश्यक हैं! जैसे सिद्धार्थ के जीवन में विद्या, धन और पद सब कुछ था। किन्तु मानवीय गुणों के कारण ही वे महात्मा बुद्ध बने।

sentences.sanskrit: एकः छात्रः: आर्ये ! के ते मानवीयाः गुणाः ?
sentences.meaning: A Student: Revered Madam! Which are those humane virtues?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्या जी! वे मानवीय गुण कौन से हैं?

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्या: सत्यं, करुणा, उदारता, सेवा, परोपकारः, अक्रोधः इत्यादयः मानवीयाः गुणाः सन्ति। अद्य एतैः गुणैः सम्बद्धाम् एकां कथां पठामः।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Truth, compassion, generosity, selfless service, benevolence, and freedom from anger are such human virtues. Today let us read a story related to these qualities.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सत्य, करुणा, उदारता, सेवा, परोपकार, क्रोध न करना आदि मानवीय गुण हैं। आज हम इन गुणों से संबंधित एक कहानी पढ़ते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: छात्राः: आम्, मान्ये ! वयम् अपि पठितुम् इच्छामः ।
sentences.meaning: Students: Yes, respected teacher! We too wish to read it.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: हाँ, आदरणीया! हम सब भी पढ़ना चाहते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: २. मुख्यकथा : नागार्जुनस्य सहायकपरीक्षा — भाग १: सहायकस्य आवश्यकता
sentences.meaning: Main Story: Nagarjuna's Assistant Selection — Part 1: The Need for an Assistant
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मुख्य कथा: नागार्जुन के सहायक की परीक्षा — भाग १: सहायक की आवश्यकता

sentences.sanskrit: नागार्जुनः प्रसिद्धः रसायनशास्त्रज्ञः चिकित्सकः च आसीत्। सः अहोरात्रं प्रयोगशालायां कार्यं करोति स्म। एकदा सः महाराजं निवेदितवान् "महाराज ! मम चिकित्साकार्याय एकः सहायकः आवश्यकः" इति। राजा एतद् अङ्गीकृतवान् उक्तवान् च 'अस्तु, अहं व्यवस्थां करोमि। श्वः केचन योग्याः युवकाः आगमिष्यन्ति। भवान् परीक्षां कृत्वा तेषु युवकेषु कमपि योग्यं स्वीकरोतु' इति ।
sentences.meaning: Nagarjuna was an illustrious chemist and physician. He worked day and night in his laboratory. Once he requested the King: 'O King! An assistant is required for my medical work.' The King accepted this request and stated: 'Very well, I shall arrange it. Tomorrow some qualified youths will arrive. You may examine them and select whichever youth is truly worthy.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: नागार्जुन एक प्रसिद्ध रसायनशास्त्री और चिकित्सक (वैद्य) थे। वे दिन-रात प्रयोगशाला में काम करते थे। एक बार उन्होंने महाराज से निवेदन किया, "महाराज! मेरे चिकित्सा कार्य के लिए एक सहायक की आवश्यकता है।" राजा ने इसे स्वीकार किया और कहा, "ठीक है, मैं व्यवस्था करता हूँ। कल कुछ योग्य युवक आएँगे। आप परीक्षा लेकर उन युवकों में से किसी योग्य व्यक्ति को चुन लीजिए।"

sentences.sanskrit: मुख्यकथा — भाग २: परीक्षायाः कार्यम् (The Test Assignment)
sentences.meaning: Main Story — Part 2: The Practical Chemical Test
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मुख्य कथा — भाग २: परीक्षा का कार्य

sentences.sanskrit: अन्यस्मिन् दिने द्वौ युवकौ आगतवन्तौ। नागार्जुनः द्वयोः विद्याभ्यासविषये पृष्टवान्। द्वयोः अपि विद्याभ्यासविषयः समानः एव आसीत्। तदा नागार्जुनः तौ एकं विशिष्टं रसायनं निर्माय आगच्छताम् इति सूचितवान्। तदर्थं दिनद्वयस्य अवसरं दत्तवान्। "गमनसमये राजमार्गेण गच्छताम्” इत्यपि सूचितवान् ।
sentences.meaning: The next day, two young men arrived. Nagarjuna inquired about their academic backgrounds; both possessed identical scholarly education. Then Nagarjuna instructed them to prepare a specific medicinal formulation and return with it. For this he granted a period of two days. He also instructed: 'While travelling, you must proceed via the highway.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अगले दिन दो युवक आए। नागार्जुन ने दोनों की पढ़ाई के विषय में पूछा। दोनों की पढ़ाई का विषय बिल्कुल समान था। तब नागार्जुन ने उन दोनों को एक विशेष रसायन (औषधि) बनाकर आने का निर्देश दिया। इसके लिए उन्होंने दो दिन का समय दिया। साथ ही यह भी निर्देश दिया कि "जाते समय राजमार्ग (मुख्य सड़क) से ही जाना।"

sentences.sanskrit: मुख्यकथा — भाग ३: प्रथमस्य युवकस्य आगमनम् (Arrival of First Youth)
sentences.meaning: Main Story — Part 3: The First Youth Returns with the Potion
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मुख्य कथा — भाग ३: पहले युवक का आगमन

sentences.sanskrit: दिनद्वयानन्तरं नागार्जुनस्य समीपे प्रथमः युवकः आगतवान्। "औषधनिर्माणे किमपि कष्टं न अभवत् खलु ?” इति नागार्जुनः पृष्टवान्। युवकः स्वनिष्ठां दर्शयितुं स्वगृहस्य समस्याः वर्णितवान् - "पितुः उदरवेदना, मातुः ज्वरः च आसीत्। तथापि अहं तत्सर्वं परित्यज्य औषधं निर्मितवान्” इति उक्त्वा नागार्जुनाय रसायनं दत्तवान् ।
sentences.meaning: Two days later, the first youth arrived before Nagarjuna. 'I trust there was no hardship in preparing the medicine?' Nagarjuna asked. To demonstrate his devotion, the young man described the difficulties at his home: 'My father had severe stomach pain and my mother had a fever. Nevertheless, setting all that aside, I prepared the medicine,' and handed over the formulation to Nagarjuna.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: दो दिन बाद नागार्जुन के पास पहला युवक आया। नागार्जुन ने पूछा, "औषधि बनाने में कोई कष्ट तो नहीं हुआ ना?" युवक ने अपनी निष्ठा दिखाने के लिए अपने घर की समस्याएँ बतानी शुरू कीं– "पिताजी के पेट में दर्द था और माताजी को बुखार था। फिर भी मैं वह सब छोड़कर औषधि बनाता रहा," ऐसा कहकर उसने नागार्जुन को रसायन सौंप दिया।

sentences.sanskrit: मुख्यकथा — भाग ४: द्वितीयस्य युवकस्य आगमनम् (Arrival of Second Youth)
sentences.meaning: Main Story — Part 4: The Second Youth Returns Empty-Handed
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मुख्य कथा — भाग ४: दूसरे युवक का आगमन

sentences.sanskrit: तदभ्यन्तरे द्वितीयः युवकः अपि आगतवान्। सः खिन्नः आसीत्। तमपि नागार्जुनः पृष्टवान्। तदा युवकः उक्तवान् “अहम् औषधं निर्मातुं न शक्तवान्” इति। "किमर्थं न शक्तवान्?" इति नागार्जुनः पृच्छति। युवकः उक्तवान् – “राजमार्गे अहं कञ्चित् रोगिणं दृष्टवान्। तस्य परिस्थितिः शोचनीया आसीत्। अहं तं स्वगृहं नीतवान्। दिनद्वयं तस्य एव सेवायां निरतः आसम्। अद्य प्रातः सः स्वस्थः अभवत्। अहं ततः साक्षात् अत्र आगतवान्। रसायननिर्माणार्थं समयम् एव न प्राप्तवान्” इति।
sentences.meaning: Meanwhile the second young man also arrived. He was sad and dejected. Nagarjuna asked him as well. The youth confessed: 'I was unable to prepare the medicine.' 'Why could you not?' inquired Nagarjuna. The youth explained: 'On the highway I saw a sick traveler whose condition was deplorable. I brought him to my home and spent two days attending to his care. This morning he regained his health. I have come straight here from there, leaving no time to formulate the chemical compound.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: इसी बीच दूसरा युवक भी आ गया। वह बहुत दुखी था। नागार्जुन ने उससे भी पूछा। तब युवक ने कहा, "मैं औषधि नहीं बना सका।" नागार्जुन ने पूछा, "क्यों नहीं बना सके?" युवक ने कहा– "राजमार्ग पर मैंने एक रोगी को देखा। उसकी हालत बहुत दयनीय थी। मैं उसे अपने घर ले गया। दो दिन तक मैं उसकी ही सेवा में लगा रहा। आज सुबह वह स्वस्थ हुआ। मैं वहाँ से सीधे यहाँ आ रहा हूँ। इसलिए मुझे रसायन बनाने का समय ही नहीं मिला।"

sentences.sanskrit: मुख्यकथा — भाग ५: नागार्जुनस्य निर्णयः (The Verdict of Nagarjuna)
sentences.meaning: Main Story — Part 5: The Wise Decision: Service Over Mechanical Task
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मुख्य कथा — भाग ५: नागार्जुन का विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय

sentences.sanskrit: तदनन्तरं नागार्जुनः द्वितीयं युवकं सहायकत्वेन स्वीकृतवान्। राजा एतं वृत्तान्तं श्रुत्वा आश्चर्यं प्रकटितवान्। सः नागार्जुनं पृष्टवान् – “प्रथमः युवकः औषधं कृत्वा आनीतवान्। द्वितीयः तथा न कृतवान्। तथापि भवान् किमर्थं द्वितीयं चितवान् ?” नागार्जुनः अवदत् – “द्वितीयः अपि औषधनिर्माणे कुशलः अस्ति। किन्तु तेन समयः न प्राप्तः, यतः सः सेवायां निरतः आसीत्। तं रोगिणम् अहं पूर्वमेव मार्गे दृष्टवान्। अतः 'राजमार्गेण गन्तव्यम्' इति अहं युवकद्वयं सूचितवान्। प्रथमः रोगिणं दृष्ट्वा अपि अग्रे गतवान्। सः यन्त्रवत् कार्यं करोति। तस्मिन् सेवायाः भावना नास्ति। सेवाभावनां विना चिकित्सकः कथं भवेत् ? अतः अहं द्वितीयस्य चयनं कृतवान्" इति।
sentences.meaning: Thereupon Nagarjuna accepted the second youth as his assistant. Hearing this account, the King expressed surprise and asked: 'The first youth prepared and brought the remedy; the second failed to do so. Why then did you choose the second?' Nagarjuna answered: 'The second youth is equally skilled in medicine, but had no time because he was devoted to saving a life. I had already placed that sick man on the highway, which is why I instructed both to take that route. The first saw the dying man and walked right past like an unfeeling machine without compassion. Without the spirit of service, how can anyone be a true healer? Hence, I selected the second youth.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: इसके बाद नागार्जुन ने दूसरे युवक को सहायक के रूप में चुन लिया। राजा यह वृत्तांत सुनकर चकित रह गए। उन्होंने नागार्जुन से पूछा– "पहला युवक औषधि बनाकर लाया। दूसरे ने ऐसा नहीं किया। फिर भी आपने दूसरे को क्यों चुना?" नागार्जुन ने उत्तर दिया– "दूसरा युवक भी औषधि बनाने में कुशल है। लेकिन उसे समय नहीं मिला क्योंकि वह सेवा में व्यस्त था। उस रोगी को मैंने पहले ही रास्ते में देख लिया था। इसीलिए मैंने दोनों युवकों को 'राजमार्ग से जाने' के लिए कहा था। पहले युवक ने रोगी को देखा, फिर भी आगे बढ़ गया। वह एक मशीन की तरह काम करता है। उसमें सेवा की भावना नहीं है। सेवा भावना के बिना कोई चिकित्सक (डॉक्टर) कैसे बन सकता है? इसलिए मैंने दूसरे युवक का चयन किया।"

sentences.sanskrit: प्रश्न १. अधोलिखितानां प्रश्नानाम् एकपदेन पदद्वयेन वा उत्तराणि —
sentences.meaning: Question 1: Answer in one or two words:
Who was the renowned physician? Answer: Nagarjuna (नागार्जुनः).
Who came on the next day? Answer: Two young men (द्वौ युवकौ).
Who was dejected and sorrowful? Answer: The second youth (द्वितीयः युवकः).
What was the patient's condition? Answer: Pitiable / Deplorable (शोचनीया).
Whom did Nagarjuna select as his assistant? Answer: The second youth (द्वितीयं युवकम्).
Without what can one not become a true healer? Answer: The spirit of service (सेवाभावनाम्).

sentences.sanskrit: (छ) नागार्जुनः युवकौ केन मार्गेण गन्तुं सूचितवान् ?
sentences.meaning: By which route did Nagarjuna instruct them to travel? Answer: By the highway (राजमार्गेण).
Question 2: Complete sentence answers:

sentences.sanskrit: (क) अहोरात्रं नागार्जुनः कुत्र कार्यं करोति स्म ?
sentences.meaning: Where did Nagarjuna work day and night?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: नागार्जुनः अहोरात्रं प्रयोगशालायां कार्यं करोति स्म।

sentences.meaning: What did Nagarjuna request the King?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: नागार्जुनः महाराजं निवेदितवान् – “महाराज ! मम चिकित्साकार्याय एकः सहायकः आवश्यकः” इति।

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) द्वितीयः युवकः राजमार्गे रोगिणं दृष्ट्वा किं कृतवान् ?
sentences.meaning: What did the second youth do on seeing the sick traveler on the highway?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: द्वितीयः युवकः राजमार्गे रोगिणं दृष्ट्वा तं स्वगृहं नीतवान् दिनद्वयं च तस्य सेवायां निरतः आसीत्।

sentences.sanskrit: (घ) सेवायाः भावनां विना किं न भवेत् ?
sentences.meaning: Without the spirit of service, what can one not become?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: सेवायाः भावनां विना चिकित्सकः न भवेत्।

sentences.sanskrit: प्रश्न ३ व ४. क्तवतु प्रत्यय रूपाणि (Past Active Participle - वान् / वती) —
sentences.meaning: Questions 3 & 4: Past Active Participle (Ktavatu suffix) forms in Masculine and Feminine:

sentences.sanskrit: पुंलिङ्गम् / स्त्रीलिङ्गम्: (१) पठितवान् — पठितवती (२) गतवान् — गतवती (३) लिखितवान् — लिखितवती (४) खादितवान् — खादितवती (५) क्रीडितवान् — क्रीडितवती (६) हसितवान् — हसितवती (७) निवेदितवान् — निवेदितवती (८) सूचितवान् — सूचितवती।
sentences.meaning: Past Participle Pairs: Pathitavan / Pathitavati (studied), Gatavan / Gatavati (went), Likhitavan / Likhitavati (wrote), Khaditavan / Khaditavati (ate), Kriditavan / Kriditavati (played), Hasitavan / Hasitavati (laughed), Niveditavan / Niveditavati (requested), Suchitavan / Suchitavati (informed).
Question 5: Sentence transformations from Present Tense to Past Participle:

sentences.sanskrit: (क) युवकः आपणं गच्छति → युवकः आपणं गतवान्। (ख) सः रोटिकां खादति → सः रोटिकां खादितवान्। (ग) महिला वस्त्रं ददाति → महिला वस्त्रं दत्तवती। (घ) बालकः द्विचक्रिकातः पतति → बालकः द्विचक्रिकातः पतितवान्। (ङ) पितामही चलच्चित्रं पश्यति → पितामही चलच्चित्रं दृष्टवती।
sentences.meaning: Transformations: Youth goes to market → Youth went to market. He eats bread → He ate bread. Woman gives clothes → Woman gave clothes. Boy falls from bicycle → Boy fell from bicycle. Grandmother watches movie → Grandmother watched movie.
Question 6: Narrative reading using 'Sma' particle for habitual past tense:

sentences.sanskrit: कृषकः प्रतिदिनं कृषिक्षेत्रं गच्छति स्म। जलसेचनं करोति स्म। सः क्षेत्रे गोमयं योजयति स्म, न तु कृतकान् पदार्थान्। अतः व्रीहेः गुणवत्ता अधिका भवति स्म। कीटानां निवारणार्थं जैवौषधं स्थापयति स्म। सः कृषिकार्यं सम्यक् जानाति स्म। सः सर्वान् वदति स्म — "कृषकः न दीनः न च दरिद्रः, परं सर्वेषां पोषकः" इति।
sentences.meaning: An Ideal Farmer: The farmer used to go to his fields daily and irrigate them. He would add organic cow dung rather than artificial chemicals. Hence grain quality was superior. For pests he applied organic pest remedies. He knew farming deeply. He proudly proclaimed to all: 'A farmer is neither miserable nor poor, but the nourisher of all mankind!'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: किसान प्रतिदिन खेत जाता था और सिंचाई करता था। वह जैविक खाद डालता था। धान की गुणवत्ता उत्तम होती थी। वह अभिमान से कहता था: 'किसान दीन अथवा दरिद्र नहीं, बल्कि सबका अन्नदाता और पोषक है!'

sentences.sanskrit: स्वास्थ्यरक्षणाय नियमाः (पृष्ठम् ५५ / Rules for Protecting Health)
sentences.meaning: Rules and Guidelines for Protecting Health from Classical Ayurveda (Page 55)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: स्वास्थ्य रक्षा के नियम

sentences.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते उत्तिष्ठेत् स्वस्थो रक्षार्थमायुषः ।
सर्वमेव परित्यज्य शरीरमनुपालयेत् ॥ १ ॥
sentences.answer_sanskrit: ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते (in early morning dawn, 1.5 hrs before sunrise) उत्तिष्ठेत् (should wake up) स्वस्थः (a healthy person) रक्षार्थम् (for the protection) आयुषः (of life longevity) । सर्वम् एव (everything else indeed) परित्यज्य (leaving aside) शरीरम् (the physical body) अनुपालयेत् (should nurture and care for) ॥
sentences.meaning: English Translation: A healthy person should wake up during the Brahma Muhurta (early dawn) to protect their longevity. Leaving aside all other tasks, one must first take care of and nurture the physical body.

sentences.sanskrit:
भोजनान्ते पिबेत् तक्रं वासरान्ते पिबेत्पयः ।
निशान्ते च पिबेत् वारि त्रिभी रोगो न जायते ॥ २ ॥
sentences.answer_sanskrit: भोजनान्ते (at meal's end) पिबेत् तक्रम् (drink buttermilk), वासरान्ते (at day's end / night) पिबेत् पयः (drink milk) । निशान्ते च (and at dawn / waking up) पिबेत् वारि (drink water) — त्रिभिः (by these three habits) रोगः न जायते (diseases never arise) ॥
sentences.meaning: English Translation: One should drink buttermilk at the end of a meal, drink milk at the end of the day (before sleep), and drink water at the end of the night (upon waking up). By practicing these three habits, diseases never arise.

sentences.sanskrit: परियोजनाकार्यम् — आयुर्वेदीयसस्यानि (पृष्ठम् ५६ / Health Protection via Ayurvedic Plants)
sentences.meaning: Project Work: Health protection through medicinal flora (Page 56)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: परियोजना कार्य - आयुर्वेदिक वनस्पतियाँ

sentences.sanskrit:
भवतां परिवेशे विद्यमानानाम् आयुर्वेदीयसस्यानां पदार्थानां च नामानि लिखन्तु । तेषां स्वास्थ्यरक्षणलाभान् लिखन्तु ।
यथा – बिल्वं पाचनक्रियां वर्धते। लवङ्गं दन्तसमस्याः कासं च नाशयति ।
sentences.answer_sanskrit:
१. बिल्वम् (Bael / Wood apple) — पाचनक्रियां वर्धयति (improves digestion)।
२. लवङ्गम् (Clove) — दन्तसमस्याः कासं च नाशयति (cures toothache and cough)।
३. तुलसी (Holy Basil) — कासस्य श्वासरोगाणां च शमनं करोति (relieves respiratory ailments)।
४. हरिद्रा (Turmeric) — व्रणरोपणं करोति रोगप्रतिकारकशक्तिं च वर्धयति (heals wounds and boosts immunity)।
sentences.meaning: English Translation: Write the names of Ayurvedic plants and substances in your surroundings along with their health benefits. For example: Bael fruit improves digestion; Clove cures dental issues and cough; Tulsi soothes coughs and respiratory issues; Turmeric heals wounds and strengthens immunity.
Exercise 4: Match Sanskrit service actions to corresponding pictures (Page 56)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभ्यास - वाक्य और चित्रों का मिलान

sentences.answer_sanskrit: धेनुमाता (Mother cow) परमशिवा (highly auspicious and benevolent)। चित्रसंयोजनम्: ५ (५th picture showing a woman offering respects/prayers to a cow).
sentences.meaning: English: Mother cow is highly auspicious and benevolent. Visual Match: Connects to the 5th picture showing a woman offering respects to a sacred cow.

sentences.answer_sanskrit: नित्यम् (daily) मातापित्रोः (of mother and father) सेवा (service and care)। चित्रसंयोजनम्: १ (१st picture showing a boy serving his elderly parents seated on a couch).
sentences.meaning: English: Serving one's parents daily. Visual Match: Connects to the 1st picture showing a boy serving his elderly parents.

sentences.answer_sanskrit: रोगातुराणाम् (of the sick/diseased people) उपचारः (nursing treatment and medical care)। चित्रसंयोजनम्: २ (२nd picture showing a nurse caring for a patient resting in a hospital bed).
sentences.meaning: English: Medical care and nursing of the sick. Visual Match: Connects to the 2nd picture showing a healthcare nurse tending to a hospitalized patient.

sentences.answer_sanskrit: गृहकार्येषु (in household chores) भगिन्याः (of sister) साहाय्यम् (help and support)। चित्रसंयोजनम्: ३ (३rd picture showing a brother and sister sweeping and tidying up the floor together).
sentences.meaning: English: Helping one's sister with household chores. Visual Match: Connects to the 3rd picture showing siblings cleaning and sweeping the home together.

sentences.answer_sanskrit: परस्परम् (mutually / each other) कार्यकरणे (in executing tasks) साहाय्यम् (cooperation and assistance)। चित्रसंयोजनम्: ४ (४th picture showing children collaboratively constructing a house using building blocks).
sentences.meaning: English: Helping each other in doing work. Visual Match: Connects to the 4th picture showing children working together collaboratively.

sentences.sanskrit: १. पाठस्य मूल-संवादः (मूल बातचीत और अंत्याक्षरी के नियम)
sentences.meaning: Lesson Introduction: Rules of Shloka Antyakshari
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मूल बातचीत और अंत्याक्षरी के नियम

sentences.sanskrit: दीपिका: सखि भारति ! वयम् अधुना क्रीडितुम् अभिलषामः।
sentences.meaning: Deepika: Friend Bharati! We desire to play right now.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सखी भारती! हम सब इस समय खेलना चाहते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: भारती: अरे भारति ! बहिः वृष्टिः अस्ति, कथं क्रीडामः ?
sentences.meaning: Bharati: Oh friend! It is raining outside, how shall we play?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे भारती! बाहर वर्षा हो रही है, कैसे खेलें?

sentences.sanskrit: एकः छात्रः: वृष्टिः अस्तु नाम। इच्छा अस्ति चेत् क्रीडामः। बहिर्गमनस्य आवश्यकता एव नास्ति। एषा नूतना क्रीडा अस्ति भोः ! ‘अन्त्याक्षरी क्रीडा’ इति।
sentences.meaning: A Student: Let the rain pour! If we have the desire, we can play. There is no need to step outside. This is a novel indoor game, friends— the game of 'Shloka Antyakshari'!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बारिश होने दो। यदि इच्छा है तो खेलेंगे। बाहर जाने की आवश्यकता ही नहीं है। अरे भाई, यह एक नया खेल है— 'अंत्याक्षरी का खेल'!

sentences.sanskrit: दीपिका: किम् अन्त्याक्षरी क्रीडा ? अहम् अपि क्रीडामि।
sentences.meaning: Deepika: What is the Antyakshari game? I too will participate and play!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: क्या अंत्याक्षरी का खेल? मैं भी खेलूँगी।

sentences.sanskrit: भारती: अवश्यम्। आगच्छन्तु। वयं सर्वे क्रीडामः। सखि! तर्हि क्रीडायाः नियमान् सूचयतु।
sentences.meaning: Bharati: By all means! Come along. We shall all play. Friend! Please explain the rules of the game to everyone.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अवश्य। आइए। हम सब खेलते हैं। सखी! तो खेल के नियम बता दो।

sentences.sanskrit: सहेली: वयं गणद्वयं रचयामः। प्रथमगणस्य नाम — ‘ज्ञानमाला’ एवं च द्वितीयगणस्य नाम — ‘रत्नमाला’। आदौ प्रथमगणस्य सदस्यः एकं पद्यं गायति। तस्य पद्यस्य अन्तिमेन व्यञ्जनवर्णेन द्वितीयगणस्य सदस्यः सदस्या वा अन्यं श्लोकं गायति, एवं क्रमशः क्रीडा प्रचलति।
sentences.meaning: Friend: We shall divide into two teams. The name of the first team is 'Jnanamala' and the second team is 'Ratnamala'. First, a member of the first team recites a shloka. Using the final consonant of that shloka, a member of the second team must recite another shloka, and so the game proceeds.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: हम दो समूह बनाते हैं। पहले समूह का नाम— 'ज्ञानमाला' और दूसरे का नाम— 'रत्नमाला' है। सबसे पहले प्रथम समूह का कोई सदस्य एक श्लोक गाएगा। उस श्लोक के अंतिम व्यंजन अक्षर से दूसरे समूह का सदस्य दूसरा श्लोक गाएगा। इस प्रकार क्रम से खेल चलता रहेगा।

sentences.sanskrit: सर्वे: अहो ! महान् आनन्दः भविष्यति, तर्हि क्रीडामः। आदौ ज्ञानमालागणः ‘र्’ इति अक्षरात् पद्यं गायति ततः रत्नमालागणः वदति।
sentences.meaning: All: Oh! It will be immense fun, let us begin! First the Jnanamala team recites a verse starting with the letter 'R', and then the Ratnamala team responds.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे! बड़ा आनंद आएगा, तो फिर खेलते हैं। सबसे पहले ज्ञानमाला समूह 'र' अक्षर से श्लोक गाएगा, उसके बाद रत्नमाला समूह उत्तर देगा।

sentences.meaning: Ten Classical Verses of the Shloka Antyakshari
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अंत्याक्षरी के १० मुख्य श्लोक

sentences.sanskrit: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना विशालकुलसम्भवाः। विद्याहीना न शोभन्ते निर्गन्धा इव किंशुकाः ॥ १ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 1 · (Starting with 'R'): People endowed with physical beauty, youth, and born into a noble family do not look graceful if they lack education, just like the scentless Palasa (Kimshuka) flowers which appear brilliant red but have no sweet fragrance.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: जो लोग सुंदर रूप और यौवन से संपन्न हैं, जिन्होंने उच्च कुल में जन्म भी लिया है, लेकिन यदि वे विद्या से रहित हैं, तो वे समाज में शोभा नहीं पाते। ठीक उसी तरह जैसे पलाश के फूल दिखने में सुंदर होते हैं, पर खुशबू न होने के कारण उपयोग में नहीं आते।

sentences.sanskrit: काव्यशास्त्रविनोदेन कालो गच्छति धीमताम्। व्यसनेन च मूर्खाणां निद्रया कलहेन वा ॥ २ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 2 · (Starting with 'K'): The time of wise and intelligent people is spent delightfully in the appreciation of poetry and philosophy (Kavya-Shastra), whereas the time of fools is squandered in vices, excessive sleep, and petty quarrels.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बुद्धिमान लोगों का समय काव्य और शास्त्रों के अध्ययन व आनंद में बीतता है, जबकि मूर्ख लोगों का समय बुरी आदतों, सोने या आपस में लड़ाई-झगड़ा करने में नष्ट होता है।

sentences.sanskrit: विद्या विवादाय धनं मदाय शक्तिः परेषां परिपीडनाय। खलस्य साधोर्विपरीतमेतत् ज्ञानाय दानाय च रक्षणाय ॥ ३ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 3 · (Starting with 'V'): For the wicked, learning leads to futile arguments, wealth fosters arrogance, and physical power is used to torment others. In contrast, for the virtuous, knowledge is for wisdom, wealth for charity, and strength for protecting the vulnerable.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: दुष्ट व्यक्ति की विद्या विवाद के लिए, धन अहंकार के लिए और शक्ति दूसरों को परेशान करने के लिए होती है। इसके विपरीत, सज्जन व्यक्ति की विद्या ज्ञान के लिए, धन दान के लिए और शक्ति कमजोरों की रक्षा के लिए होती है।

sentences.sanskrit: येषां न विद्या न तपो न दानं ज्ञानं न शीलं न गुणो न धर्मः। ते मर्त्यलोके भुवि भारभूता मनुष्यरूपेण मृगाश्चरन्ति ॥ ४ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 4 · (Starting with 'Y'): Those who possess neither learning, nor penance, nor generosity, nor true wisdom, nor good character, nor virtues, nor righteousness; they are merely a dead weight upon this earth, roaming like beasts in human disguise.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: जिन मनुष्यों के पास न विद्या है, न तप, न दान, न ज्ञान, न अच्छा चरित्र, न गुण और न धर्म; वे लोग इस पृथ्वी पर केवल एक बोझ हैं और मनुष्य के रूप में पशुओं की तरह भटकते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: तदा वृतिश्च कीर्तिश्च लक्ष्मीर्वाणी यशस्विनी। तत्त्वज्ञानं परा शान्तिर्यदा विद्या भवेत्तव ॥ ५ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 5 · (Starting with 'T'): When you genuinely possess learning, then noble livelihood, fame, prosperity, eloquent speech, essential truth, and supreme peace naturally become yours.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: जब तुम्हारे पास सच्ची विद्या होती है, तब तुम्हारी आजीविका, यश, धन-संपत्ति, मधुर वाणी, वास्तविक ज्ञान और परम शांति स्वतः ही प्राप्त हो जाती है।

sentences.sanskrit: विद्या नाम नरस्य रूपमधिकं प्रच्छन्नगुप्तं धनं विद्या भोगकरी यशःसुखकरी विद्या गुरूणां गुरुः। विद्या बन्धुजनो विदेशगमने विद्या परा देवता विद्या राजसु पूज्यते न हि धनं विद्याविहीनः पशुः ॥ ६ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 6 · (Starting with 'V'): Knowledge is human being's highest adornment and secretly protected wealth. Knowledge brings comforts, renown, and happiness. It is the teacher of teachers. In foreign lands, it is our truest kinsman. In royal courts, knowledge is revered, not mere wealth. One devoid of knowledge is truly an animal.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: विद्या मनुष्य का वास्तविक सौंदर्य और छिपा हुआ सुरक्षित धन है। विद्या सुख-साधन जुटाने वाली, कीर्ति और आनंद देने वाली है। विद्या गुरुओं की भी गुरु है। विदेश जाने पर विद्या ही सबसे बड़ी मित्र बनती है। राजाओं द्वारा विद्या का सम्मान होता है, धन का नहीं। इसलिए विद्या से रहित व्यक्ति पशु के समान है।

sentences.sanskrit: शनैः पन्थाः शनैः कन्था शनैः पर्वतलङ्घनम्। शनैर्विद्या शनैर्वित्तं पञ्चैतानि शनैः शनैः ॥ ७ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 7 · (Starting with 'Sh'): Travelling a long road, stitching a quilt, crossing a mountain, acquiring deep learning, and accumulating wealth— these five pursuits must be accomplished steadily, step by step.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: रास्ता धीरे-धीरे पार करना चाहिए, वस्त्र धीरे-धीरे सिलना चाहिए, पहाड़ धीरे-धीरे चढ़ना चाहिए, विद्या धीरे-धीरे सीखनी चाहिए और धन भी धीरे-धीरे कमाना चाहिए— ये पाँचों कार्य धीरे-धीरे (धैर्य से) ही सिद्ध होते हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: न विद्यया विना सौख्यं नराणां जायते ध्रुवम्। अतो धर्मार्थमोक्षेभ्यो विद्याभ्यासं समाचरेत् ॥ ८ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 8 · (Starting with 'N'): Without knowledge, humans certainly can never attain genuine happiness. Therefore, for the attainment of Dharma (righteousness), Artha (prosperity), and Moksha (liberation), one must diligently practice learning.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: विद्या के बिना मनुष्यों को निश्चित रूप से वास्तविक सुख प्राप्त नहीं हो सकता। इसलिए धर्म, अर्थ और मोक्ष की प्राप्ति के लिए निरंतर विद्या का अभ्यास करना चाहिए।

sentences.sanskrit: ताराणां भूषणं चन्द्रः लतानां भूषणं सुमम्। पृथिव्याः भूषणं राजा विद्या सर्वस्य भूषणम् ॥ ९ ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 9 · (Starting with 'T'): The ornament of stars is the moon; the ornament of flowering vines is the blossom; the ornament of the earth is a righteous ruler; and education is the supreme adornment of every human being.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: तारों का आभूषण चंद्रमा है, लताओं का आभूषण फूल है, पृथ्वी का आभूषण राजा है और विद्या सभी का आभूषण है।

sentences.sanskrit: न चोरहार्यं न च राजहार्यं न भ्रातृभाज्यं न च भारकारि। व्यये कृते वर्धत एव नित्यं विद्याधनं सर्वधनप्रधानम् ॥ १० ॥
sentences.meaning: Shloka 10 · (Starting with 'N'): Knowledge cannot be stolen by thieves, nor confiscated by kings; it cannot be partitioned among brothers, nor is it cumbersome to carry. When shared and expended, it increases daily. Thus the treasure of knowledge is supreme among all treasures.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: विद्या रूपी धन ऐसा है जिसे न तो चोर चुरा सकता है, न राजा छीन सकता है, न भाइयों में इसे बाँटा जा सकता है और न ही यह कोई बोझ बनता है। यह खर्च करने पर हर दिन बढ़ता ही जाता है; इसलिए विद्या का धन सभी धनों में सर्वश्रेष्ठ है।

Exercises with Solved Answers
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अभ्यास कार्य

sentences.meaning: Question 1: One-word answers:

sentences.sanskrit: (क) विद्याहीनाः कीदृशाः किंशुकाः इव न शोभन्ते ?
sentences.meaning: Devoid of learning, people do not shine like what kind of Kimshuka flowers? Answer: Scentless (निर्गन्धाः).
How does the time of the wise pass? Answer: In enjoyment of literature and science (काव्यशास्त्रविनोदेन).

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) केषां कालः निद्रया कलहेन वा गच्छति ?
sentences.meaning: Whose time passes in sleep or quarrel? Answer: Of fools (मूर्खाणाम्).
What is the knowledge of the wicked for? Answer: For arguments/dispute (विवादाय).
What is the knowledge of the good person for? Answer: For wisdom (ज्ञानाय).
The moon is the ornament of what? Answer: Of the stars (ताराणाम्).
What is supreme among all forms of wealth? Answer: The wealth of learning (विद्याधनम्).
Question 2: Complete sentence answers:

sentences.sanskrit: (क) निर्गन्धाः किंशुकाः इव के न शोभन्ते ?
sentences.meaning: Who do not look graceful like scentless Palasa flowers?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: रूपयौवनसम्पन्नाः विशालकुलसम्भवाः च जनाः यदि विद्याहीनाः सन्ति, तर्हि ते निर्गन्धाः किंशुकाः इव न शोभन्ते।

sentences.meaning: How does the time of foolish people pass?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: मूर्खाणां कालः व्यसनेन, निद्रया, कलहेन वा गच्छति।

sentences.sanskrit: (ग) दुर्जनः विद्यायाः धनस्य शक्तेः च उपयोगं कथं करोति ?
sentences.meaning: How does a wicked person use learning, wealth, and strength?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: दुर्जनः विद्यायाः उपयोगं विवादाय, धनस्य उपयोगं मदाय, शक्तेः च उपयोगं परेषां परिपीडनाय करोति।

sentences.meaning: Which five things should be accomplished step by step?
sentences.answer_sanskrit: पन्थाः (मार्गः), कन्था (वस्त्रसीवनम्), पर्वतलङ्घनम्, विद्या, वित्तं (धनम्) च एतानि पञ्च कार्याणि शनैः शनैः साधनीयानि।

sentences.meaning: Classroom Introduction: Is God Everywhere?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: कक्षा की भूमिका: ईश्वर की सर्वव्यापकता

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापिका: अयि भोः बालाः ! किं भवन्तः जानन्ति 'ईश्वरः कुत्र अस्ति' ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Hello dear children! Do you know where God resides?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे ओ बच्चों! क्या आप सब जानते हैं कि ईश्वर कहाँ है?

sentences.meaning: Student: Respected teacher! God lives in the temple.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: महोदया! ईश्वर मंदिर में होता है।

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापिका: वत्साः ! ईश्वरः न केवलं देवालये अपितु सर्वत्र व्याप्तः अस्ति। किम् 'ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वं' इति न श्रुतवन्तः ?
sentences.meaning: Teacher: Dear children! God is not only in temples, but omnipresent everywhere. Have you not heard the sacred Upanishadic truth: 'All this is pervaded by God'?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: बच्चों! ईश्वर न केवल मंदिर में बल्कि सब जगह समाया हुआ है। क्या आपने 'ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वं' नहीं सुना है?

sentences.sanskrit: छात्राः: नैव आर्ये ! तस्य कः अर्थः ?
sentences.meaning: Students: No, revered teacher! What does that mean?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: नहीं आचार्या जी! उसका क्या अर्थ है?

sentences.sanskrit: अध्यापिका: एतत् सर्वं जगत् ईशेन व्याप्तम् अस्ति। ईश्वरः सर्वत्र अस्ति। पुरा कश्चन भवादृशः अल्पवयस्कः बालः 'ईश्वरः सर्वत्र अस्ति' इति दर्शितवान्। इदानीं भक्तप्रह्लादस्य नाटकं पठामः।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: All this moving universe is enveloped and filled by the Divine Spirit. Long ago, a young child like you demonstrated that God is everywhere. Now let us read the dramatic play of Bhakta Prahlada.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: यह सारा संसार ईश्वर से व्याप्त है। प्राचीन काल में आप जैसा ही एक छोटा बालक था जिसने दिखाया था कि 'ईश्वर सब जगह है'। अब हम भक्त प्रह्लाद का नाटक पढ़ते हैं।

sentences.meaning: Play: Bhakta Prahlada — Scene 1: The Royal Court of Hiranyakashipu
sentences.paragraphTranslation: नाटक: भक्त प्रह्लाद — दृश्य १: हिरण्यकशिपु की राजसभा

sentences.sanskrit: राजभटः: अयि भोः सावधानाः तिष्ठन्तु। राजाधिराजः त्रैलोक्याधिपतिः दैत्यराजः हिरण्यकशिपुः आगच्छति।
sentences.meaning: Royal Guard: Attention everyone! The sovereign emperor, lord of the three realms, king of demons Hiranyakashipu is arriving!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: अरे ओ, सब सावधान हो जाओ। राजाओं के राजा, तीनों लोकों के स्वामी, दैत्यराज हिरण्यकशिपु पधार रहे हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुः: ह ह ह ह.... अहम् एव सर्वशक्तिमान् अस्मि । अहम् अमरः अस्मि । सर्वत्र जनाः मामेव ध्यायन्ति खलु !
sentences.meaning: Hiranyakashipu: Ha ha ha! I alone am all-powerful! I am immortal! Everywhere subjects meditate upon me alone, do they not?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: हाहाहा... मैं ही सबसे शक्तिशाली हूँ। मैं अमर हूँ। सब जगह लोग मेरा ही ध्यान करते हैं ना!

sentences.sanskrit: मन्त्री: सत्यं देव ! किन्तु... भवतः पुत्रः प्रह्लादः अहर्निशं भवतः शत्रोः विष्णोः गुणगानं करोति।
sentences.meaning: Minister: True, O Lord! Yet... your own son Prahlada sings day and night the praises of your sworn enemy, Lord Vishnu (Hari).
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सत्य है देव! लेकिन... आपका पुत्र प्रह्लाद दिन-रात आपके शत्रु भगवान विष्णु का गुणगान करता है।

sentences.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुः: (सक्रोधम्) आः ! सः कुलकलङ्कः ! तम् आनयन्तु अत्र !
sentences.meaning: Hiranyakashipu: (In fury) Ah! That stain upon our clan! Bring him before me this instant!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: (क्रोध में) आह! वह कुल का कलंक! उसे तुरंत यहाँ लाओ!

sentences.meaning: Scene 2: Confrontation between Hiranyakashipu and Prahlada
sentences.paragraphTranslation: दृश्य २: हिरण्यकशिपु और प्रह्लाद का संवाद

sentences.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुः: प्रह्लाद ! कः श्रेष्ठः ? अहम् उत तव हरिः ?
sentences.meaning: Hiranyakashipu: Prahlada! Who is supreme? Am I greater, or your Hari?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: प्रह्लाद! कौन श्रेष्ठ है? मैं या तुम्हारा हरि?

sentences.sanskrit: प्रह्लादः: तात ! हरिः एव सर्वशक्तिमान्, सर्वव्यापी, जगत्पालकः च। सः सर्वत्र अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Prahlada: Respected Father! Lord Hari alone is all-powerful, omnipresent, and the protector of the cosmos. He exists everywhere.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पिता जी! हरि ही सर्वशक्तिमान, सर्वव्यापी और संसार के पालनकर्ता हैं। वे सब जगह हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुः: (क्रोधेन गर्जति) सर्वत्र अस्ति ? तर्हि अस्मिन् स्तम्भे अपि अस्ति किम् ?
sentences.meaning: Hiranyakashipu: (Roaring in rage) Everywhere? Then is He present inside this stone pillar as well?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: (क्रोध से गरजते हुए) सब जगह है? तो क्या इस खंभे में भी है?

sentences.sanskrit: प्रह्लादः: आम् तात ! अस्मिन् स्तम्भे अपि भगवान् अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Prahlada: Yes, Father! The Supreme Lord is present right here in this pillar too.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: हाँ पिता जी! इस खंभे में भी भगवान हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुः: (गदया स्तम्भं प्रहरति) पश्यामि अधुना तव हरिम् !
sentences.meaning: Hiranyakashipu: (Strikes the pillar with his heavy mace) I shall see your Hari now!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: (गदा से खंभे पर वार करता है) देखता हूँ अभी तुम्हारे हरि को!

sentences.sanskrit: दृश्य ३ : नृसिंहस्य प्रादुर्भावः (Appearance of Lord Narasimha)
sentences.meaning: Scene 3: The Divine Manifestation of Lord Narasimha
sentences.paragraphTranslation: दृश्य ३: भगवान नृसिंह का प्राकट्य

sentences.sanskrit: (स्तम्भात् भयानकगर्जनपूर्वकं भगवान् नृसिंहः आविर्भवति। सः हिरण्यकशिपुं देहल्याम् उपवेश्य नखैः विदारयति।)
sentences.meaning: (With a deafening cosmic roar, Lord Narasimha emerges from the cracked pillar. Placing Hiranyakashipu upon the threshold at twilight, He destroys the tyrant with His claws.)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: (खंभे से भयंकर गर्जना के साथ भगवान नृसिंह प्रकट होते हैं। वे हिरण्यकशिपु को देहरी पर बिठाकर नाखूनों से उसका संहार करते हैं।)

sentences.sanskrit: भगवान् नृसिंहः: प्रह्लाद ! वरं वृणीष्व। तव भक्त्या अहम् अतिप्रसन्नः अस्मि।
sentences.meaning: Lord Narasimha: Prahlada, my child! Ask for a boon. I am deeply pleased with your unshakeable devotion.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: भगवान नृसिंह: प्रह्लाद! वरदान माँगो। तुम्हारी भक्ति से मैं बहुत प्रसन्न हूँ।

sentences.sanskrit: प्रह्लादः: भगवन् ! मह्यं किमपि वरं मास्तु। केवलं भवति मे अचला भक्तिः स्यात्। मम पितुः सद्गतिः भवतु।
sentences.meaning: Prahlada: O Supreme Lord! I ask for no worldly boons. Grant only that my devotion to You remains forever steadfast, and may my father attain liberation.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: प्रह्लाद: हे भगवन्! मुझे कोई सांसारिक वरदान नहीं चाहिए। केवल आपमें मेरी अविचल भक्ति रहे और मेरे पिता को सद्गति मिले।

sentences.sanskrit: ईशावास्यम् इदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् । तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद् धनम् ॥
sentences.meaning: Isha Upanishad (Verse 1): Everything animate and inanimate within this cosmic universe is pervaded by God. Enjoy and protect creation through detached renunciation; do not covet anyone else's wealth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: इस संसार में जो कुछ भी चराचर जगत् है, वह सब ईश्वर से व्याप्त है। त्याग भाव से इसका उपभोग करो और किसी के धन का लालच मत करो।

sentences.meaning: Who is the king of demons? Answer: Hiranyakashipu (हिरण्यकशिपुः).
Whose praises did Prahlada sing? Answer: Of Lord Vishnu / Hari (विष्णोः / हरेः).
From where did Lord Narasimha emerge? Answer: From the pillar (स्तम्भात्).
Where is God? Answer: Everywhere (सर्वत्र व्याप्तः).

lessons.title: Chapter 8: हितं मनोहारि च दुर्लभं वचः

sentences.meaning: Dialogue: The Treasure of Wise Epigrams (Suktis)
sentences.paragraphTranslation: मूल बातचीत: सूक्तियों की महिमा

sentences.sanskrit: छात्रः: आचार्य ! अद्य मम माता माम् एकां सूक्तिम् अपाठयत् — 'सत्यं वद, धर्मं चर' इति।
sentences.meaning: Student: Teacher! Today my mother taught me an epigram (sukti) — 'Speak truth, practice righteousness.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्य! आज मेरी माता ने मुझे एक सूक्ति पढ़ाई— 'सत्य बोलो, धर्म का आचरण करो'।

sentences.meaning: Student: Teacher! What is meant by the word 'Sukti'?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: आचार्य! 'सूक्ति' कहने का क्या अभिप्राय है?

sentences.sanskrit: आचार्यः: सुष्ठु उक्तिः इति सूक्तिः। सुवचनम् इत्यर्थः। अस्माकं संस्कृतसाहित्ये सूक्तीनां विशालः भाण्डागारः अस्ति। एताः सूक्तयः जीवने मार्गदर्शनं कुर्वन्ति।
sentences.meaning: Teacher: 'Su-ukti' means well-spoken words or pearls of wisdom. In our Sanskrit literature there is a vast treasury of wise suktis that offer lifelong guidance.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: सुन्दर और हितकारी वचन को सूक्ति कहते हैं। हमारे संस्कृत साहित्य में सूक्तियों का विशाल भंडार है, जो जीवन में सही मार्गदर्शन करती हैं।

sentences.meaning: Celebrated Sanskrit Aphorisms and Epigrams
sentences.paragraphTranslation: प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत सूक्तियाँ एवं उनके भावार्थ

sentences.meaning: 1. Words that are both wholesome/beneficial and charmingly pleasant are extremely rare in this world.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: १. हितकारी और साथ ही मन को प्रिय लगने वाली वाणी अत्यंत दुर्लभ होती है। (भारवि - किरातार्जुनीयम्)

sentences.meaning: 2. A precious gem does not go searching for an admirer; rather, worthy seekers seek out the gem.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: २. रत्न किसी को ढूँढ़ने नहीं जाता, बल्कि रत्न को सब खोजते हैं। (कालिदास - कुमारसम्भवम्)

sentences.meaning: 3. Good character and noble conduct is the supreme ornament of a human being.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ३. सदाचार और अच्छा चरित्र ही मनुष्य का सबसे श्रेष्ठ आभूषण है।

sentences.meaning: 4. A healthy physical body is indeed the primary instrument for performing all duties and righteousness.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ४. निश्चय ही शरीर ही सभी कर्तव्यों और धर्म को पूरा करने का पहला साधन है।

sentences.sanskrit: ५. गुणाः पूजास्थानं गुणिषु न च लिङ्गं न च वयः । (उत्तररामचरितम्)
sentences.meaning: 5. Among virtuous people, virtues alone command respect— neither gender nor age determines true worth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ५. गुणवानों में गुणों का ही आदर होता है, लिंग (स्त्री/पुरुष) या आयु का नहीं।

sentences.meaning: 6. The success of noble deeds lies in the inner resolve and courage of great souls, not in outer equipment.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ६. महान लोगों के कार्यों की सफलता उनके आत्मबल और संकल्प पर निर्भर करती है, बाहरी साधनों पर नहीं।

sentences.meaning: 7. Every single moment should be utilized to acquire learning, and every tiny grain/penny to build wealth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: ७. एक-एक पल का उपयोग विद्या के लिए और एक-एक कण का उपयोग धन संचय के लिए करना चाहिए।

sentences.meaning: What kind of speech is rare? Answer: Beneficial and pleasing words (हितं मनोहारि च वचः).
Does a gem search for an owner? Answer: It does not search; it is sought (न अन्विष्यति, मृग्यते).

sentences.sanskrit: १. पाठस्य मूल-संवादः (माता और पुत्री के बीच बातचीत)
sentences.meaning: Lesson Introduction: Dialogue on the Cosmic Cycle of Creation and Food
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता और पुत्री के बीच बातचीत: सृष्टि एवं अन्न की उत्पत्ति

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: अम्ब ! मम काचिद् जिज्ञासा अस्ति। वयं मनुष्याः प्राणिनः कीटाः च कथं भूलोके आगताः?
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Mother! I have a question born of deep curiosity. How did we human beings, animals, and creatures arrive on this earth?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - माँ! मेरी एक जिज्ञासा है। हम मनुष्य, पशु-पक्षी और कीड़े इस धरती पर कैसे आए?

sentences.sanskrit: माता: वत्से ! तदर्थं भवती प्रथमं पृथिव्याः उत्पत्तिक्रमं जानीयात्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Dear child! For that you must first understand the cosmic sequence of earth's creation.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - बेटी! उसके लिए तुम्हें सबसे पहले पृथ्वी की उत्पत्ति का क्रम जानना चाहिए।

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: अहो ! रोचकं स्यात् कृपया श्रावयतु।
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Oh! That must be fascinating, please tell me!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - अरे! यह तो बहुत दिलचस्प होगा, कृपया सुनाइए।

sentences.sanskrit: माता: अस्तु ! प्रथमं ब्रह्मणः आकाशस्य उत्पत्तिः अभवत्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Very well! First from Brahma (the primordial cosmic conscious energy), Akasha (space/ether) emerged.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - ठीक है! सबसे पहले ब्रह्म (परम चेतना) से आकाश उत्पन्न हुआ।

sentences.meaning: Daughter: Mother, what does 'Brahma' mean?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - माँ, ब्रह्म कहने का क्या मतलब है?

sentences.sanskrit: माता: ब्रह्म इत्युक्ते चेतना-शक्तिः, ऊर्जा वा या सर्वत्र व्याप्ता अस्ति। यथा – आकाशः अणुः च सर्वत्र व्याप्तः अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Brahma means the omnipresent conscious power or energy that pervades everything, just as space and atomic particles permeate all reality.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - ब्रह्म का अर्थ है वह चेतना-शक्ति या ऊर्जा जो सब जगह फैली हुई है, जैसे आकाश और परमाणु सर्वत्र व्याप्त हैं।

sentences.sanskrit: माता: आकाशात् वायुः उत्पन्नः। वायोः अग्निः उत्पन्नः। अग्नेः जलस्य उत्पत्तिः अभवत्। जलात् पृथिव्याः उत्पत्तिः अभवत्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: From space, Vayu (air/atmosphere) arose. From air, Agni (fire/energy) arose. From fire, Jala (water) arose. From water, Prithvi (earth/matter) formed.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - आकाश से वायु, वायु से अग्नि, अग्नि से जल, और जल से पृथ्वी (धरती) की उत्पत्ति हुई।

sentences.sanskrit: माता: पृथिव्याः ओषधीनां सस्यानां वृक्षादीनां च उत्पत्तिः अभवत्। सस्येभ्यः आहारस्य उत्पत्तिः अभवत्।
sentences.meaning: Mother: From the fertile earth, herbs, crops, and trees blossomed. From agricultural crops, nutritious food (Anna) emerged.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - पृथ्वी से औषधियों, फसलों और पेड़-पौधों की उत्पत्ति हुई। फसलों और वनस्पतियों से आहार (अन्न) उत्पन्न हुआ।

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: आम्, आहारात् कीटाः, प्राणिनः, मनुष्याः उत्पन्नाः खलु अम्ब ?
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Yes! And from that sustenance of food, all insects, creatures, and human beings are born and nourished, right Mother?
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - हाँ, अन्न (भोजन) से ही समस्त कीड़े, पशु-पक्षी और मनुष्य पैदा हुए और पलते हैं ना माँ?

sentences.sanskrit: माता: अहो ! मम पुत्री बहु चतुरा अस्ति। सत्यम् उक्तवती भवती।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Splendid! My daughter is truly clever. You spoke the exact truth.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - अरे! मेरी बेटी बहुत बुद्धिमान है। तुमने बिल्कुल सच कहा।

sentences.sanskrit:
माता: श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतायाम् अपि भगवान् श्रीकृष्णः उक्तवान् —
'अन्नाद् भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः ।
यज्ञाद् भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः ॥'
sentences.meaning: Mother: In the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita, Lord Krishna similarly declares: 'From food all living beings arise; food is produced by rain; rain is generated by yajna (harmonious ecological sacrifice); and yajna is born of dutiful right action.'
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता में भी भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने कहा है— 'अन्न से सभी प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं, अन्न की उत्पत्ति वर्षा से होती है, वर्षा यज्ञ से होती है और यज्ञ सत्कर्मों से उत्पन्न होता है।'

sentences.sanskrit: पुत्री: अहो ! अहम् अपि उपनिषदं गीतां च पठामि अम्ब !
sentences.meaning: Daughter: Oh marvelous! I too shall study the Upanishads and the Gita, Mother!
sentences.paragraphTranslation: पुत्री - वाह माँ! मैं भी उपनिषद और गीता पढ़ूँगी!

sentences.sanskrit: माता: अवश्यम् उपनिषद्-ग्रन्थाः पठनीयाः। यतः अस्माकं भारतस्य मौलिकं ज्ञानं तेषु निहितम् अस्ति।
sentences.meaning: Mother: Certainly, the Upanishads must be studied, for the foundational wisdom of our Bharat is enshrined within them.
sentences.paragraphTranslation: माता - उपनिषद् अवश्य पढ़ने चाहिए क्योंकि भारत का मूल ज्ञान उन्हीं में समाया हुआ है।
